label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
definition: Organization or business unit X is a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational part of parent Y.
scope_notes: Preserves prior subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit unit, part, subsidiary or owned-by qualifies; an unnamed local office represented only by a city is ambiguous.

facts.reason: DDB Needham is explicitly Omnicom unit/part and owned by it.
American Airlines is explicitly AMR unit/subsidiary/part and owned by it.
Lorillard Tobacco is explicitly Loews subsidiary and unit.
NBC is explicitly a General Electric Company subsidiary/unit and owned by it.
New York has office-of and unit-of paths to Hill but also senator/campaign paths; city and Hill referents do not identify a unique corporate unit/parent.
facts.reviewer_question: Which New York office or unit and which Hill organization are meant, and do these rows refer to the same pair?
